title: C: JSON Serializer
description: Serialize a struct to a JSON string using sprintf and string concatenation.

steps.title: Serialize to JSON
steps.description: Define a `Person` struct with name (char[32]), age (int), and salary (double). Write `void to_json(Person *p, char *buf)` that creates a JSON string like `{"name":"Alice","age":30,"salary":75000.50}`. Test it.
hints: Use `sprintf` to build the JSON string.
Escape double quotes inside the string.

verification.failureMessage: Serialize the Person struct to JSON
